`final class SignalReplaySite`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.internal.signal.replay` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SignalReplaySite.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/internal/signal/replay/SignalReplaySite.java)

## Creation details

<a id="SignalReplaySite-factory-analyze"></a>

### analyze

`SignalReplaySite analyze(SignalReplayClass replayClass, StackTraceElement caller, String setter)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

**Throws:**

- `SignalReplayException`: …

Finds the calls of `setter` on the line of `caller` and slices their arguments.
Throws a [`SignalReplayException`](/reference/signals/signalreplayexception/) when the line holds no such call.

<a id="SignalReplaySite-factory-fail"></a>

### fail

`SignalReplaySite fail(SignalReplayException exception)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Returns a site that remembers why its line cannot be followed.

## Method details

<a id="SignalReplaySite-method-isPassThrough"></a>

### isPassThrough

`boolean isPassThrough()` 

If `true`, the call only passes a parameter of its method on, so the replay looks for the expression one frame higher in the stack.

<a id="SignalReplaySite-method-encloses"></a>

### encloses

`boolean encloses(SignalReplaySlice slice)` 

If `true`, one of the slices of the site encloses `slice`.

<a id="SignalReplaySite-method-getSliceList"></a>

### getSliceList

`List<SignalReplaySlice> getSliceList()` 

Returns the slices of the arguments.

<a id="SignalReplaySite-method-getFailure"></a>

### getFailure

`SignalReplayException getFailure()` 

Returns why the line cannot be followed, or `null`.
